Our Concept

Users customise an avatar to represent themselves and other people impacted by the situation.
A digital simulation of reality lets users test how decisions may impact the immediate future.
Different perspectives can be considered, helping the user make a more informed choice.
Concept
Character actions are influenced by personality traits and digital memory.
Users can connect with their cultural roots and identity background.
The twin is predictive. It produces potential outcomes that are not guaranteed to occur.

Meet Amelia

24 years old · Toronto, Canada · First-generation immigrant household · PhD Candidate in Art & Cultural Management in Europe.

Highly reflective Future-oriented Independent but lonely
MemoriesGrowing up in a first-generation immigrant family in Toronto; carrying the weight of her parents’ sacrifices; moving to Europe for doctoral study.
Personality TraitsHighly reflective, curious, perfectionistic, future-oriented, independent but often lonely.
FearsChoosing wrong, disappointing family, closing doors forever, losing either security or passion.
GoalsLive authentically, make her family proud, do meaningful work, grow personally, feel cultural belonging, and choose her own path.
Communication StyleCareful, reflective, and emotionally precise. Amelia often explains context before making a point, asks for reassurance, and uses writing to process uncertainty.
AI GeneratesA predictive twin that maps regret sensitivity, optimization fatigue, emotional isolation, and possible future paths.

Tech Support

The technical framework combines AI modelling, data infrastructure, interface systems, and privacy safeguards.

AI / ML Components

  • Large language models
  • Personality modelling
  • Emotional simulation engine
  • Scenario decision trees

Data Infrastructure

  • User profile database
  • Simulation archive
  • Vector DB search
  • Calendar and context APIs

Platform Interface

  • Web app or PWA
  • 3D / immersive UI layer
  • LLM API integration
  • Data visualisation library

Security & Ethics

  • End-to-end encryption
  • Consent management
  • Bias detection
  • Ethical guardrails

Scenario Simulation

Amelia has asked her Digital Twin to compare two possible career paths and imagine the emotional, practical, and relational outcomes of each choice.

Option A

Stay Close to Home

Community Arts Coordinator
Good Outcome
  • Promoted to Program Director within 3 years
  • Builds strong local connections
  • Maintains close relationships with family
  • Reports high life satisfaction and low stress

“I found purpose without leaving home.”

Neutral Outcome
  • Stable career with modest salary growth
  • Comfortable lifestyle but limited advancement
  • Occasionally wonders what opportunities she missed

“Life is good, but I sometimes think about the road not taken.”

Challenging Outcome
  • Organization faces budget cuts
  • Career growth stagnates
  • Feels stuck and regrets avoiding bigger opportunities

“I chose safety, but now I feel trapped.”

Option B

Move Abroad

International Cultural Consultant
Good Outcome
  • Quickly advances in an international organization
  • Leads impactful cultural projects
  • Builds a global network
  • Achieves financial independence

“Taking the risk changed my life.”

Neutral Outcome
  • Enjoys new experiences but struggles with work-life balance
  • Career grows steadily
  • Misses family and home from time to time

“I grew professionally, but the trade-offs were real.”

Challenging Outcome
  • Difficulty adapting to a new country
  • Experiences loneliness and burnout
  • Job expectations exceed reality

“The opportunity was exciting, but I underestimated the challenges.”

Outcome Analysis / Future Results

Life Path does not choose for Amelia. It shows how each path may shape her values: family connection, cultural belonging, growth, security, and regret sensitivity.

Lower Stress Path
Stay Close to Home protects family closeness and daily stability.
Higher Growth Path
Move Abroad expands professional possibility, but raises emotional risk.
Twin Reflection
“The right choice may be the one Amelia can keep choosing, even after the trade-offs become real.”

Terms & Conditions

Welcome to Life Path

Before creating your Digital Twin, please read and agree to the following:

By continuing, you consent to Life Path collecting and processing information that you choose to provide, including but not limited to:

  • Social media activity and interactions
  • Photos and videos
  • Chat histories and memories
  • Uploaded documents and files
  • Personal profile information
  • Goals, preferences, and life experiences
  • Contextual and environmental data relevant to simulations

This information is used solely to create, train, and evolve your Digital Twin so it can better understand your values, memories, personality, and decision-making patterns.

Important Information

Your Digital Twin is not you.

It is an AI-generated model designed to simulate possible futures and explore potential consequences of decisions.

All simulations, predictions, and recommendations are speculative and should not be considered factual, guaranteed, or authoritative.

AI systems can make mistakes. Always independently verify important information and do not rely solely on Life Path when making financial, legal, medical, educational, or other significant life decisions.

Emotional Impact

Some simulations may explore difficult or sensitive scenarios and could evoke emotions such as uncertainty, regret, anxiety, or discomfort.

By using Life Path, you acknowledge and accept that these experiences may occur.

Privacy & Data Ownership

We will never sell, share, or distribute your personal data to third parties.

All personal data remains stored locally on your device whenever possible and is not accessible remotely by other users.

You may review, modify, export, or permanently delete your data and Digital Twin at any time.

Open Source License

Life Path is distributed under the GNU License.

Users are free to study, modify, and distribute this project, provided that:

  • This license remains intact.
  • Modified versions remain open-source.
  • Source code is made available with any distribution.

By continuing, you confirm that:

☐ I understand what data may be collected and processed.

☐ I consent to Life Path accessing the data sources I authorize, including social media content, photos, documents, and personal memories.

☐ I understand that AI-generated simulations are not guaranteed predictions.

☐ I understand that Life Path may generate inaccurate, incomplete, or unexpected results.

☐ I understand that some content may be emotionally challenging.

☐ I consent to the creation and ongoing evolution of my Digital Twin.

Every version of your future begins with a choice.

Life Path does not decide your future. It helps you explore the futures that may be possible.

Generate Your Digital Twin

Help us understand how you think, feel, and make decisions.

Part 1 — Personality Calibration

1. When facing an important life decision, what do you usually do?
2. Which statement describes you best?
3. When you imagine your future, what matters most?
4. If something goes wrong, your first reaction is usually:
5. Which quote feels most like you?

Part 2 — Building Your Twin’s Memory

6. What is your favorite food?
7. What is your favorite movie, TV show, game, or book? Why does it resonate with you?
8. What is one memory you never want to forget?
9. Who has influenced your life the most? What did they teach you?
10. If you could give your future self one piece of advice, what would it be?
